headline: Bitcoin has slipped back below $60,000 as a reported US tariff plan and a tech-stock sell-off hit risky assets, with Wednesday's inflation report the next big test before the Fed's 9 December decision.

market.asOf: Bitcoin price read on CoinMarketCap at about 19:57 UTC Tue 24 Nov (02:57 Wed Bangkok); Binance showed $59,494 at 16:05 UTC. Sources disagreed on the 24-hour change for all three coins and on ether and solana prices, so those are left out. Use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: 11 ("Extreme Fear") on Alternative.me's Crypto Fear & Greed Index; CoinMarketCap's Fear and Greed Index read 9. Both read about 19:55 UTC 24 Nov.

stories.title: Bitcoin slips below $60,000 again as a tariff report and a tech-stock sell-off hit risky assets
stories.summary: Monday's Nvidia-driven stock rally faded on Tuesday after a report that the US could soon raise tariffs on many trading partners. Chip stocks fell hard and bitcoin dropped back under $60,000. Money is still leaving US bitcoin funds, and analysts are watching June's low near $58,500.
points: Bitcoin was at $59,800 at 10:32am ET, down 5.8% over 24 hours, with ether down about 6% and XRP and solana about 10%, per CoinDesk.
Bitcoin dipped below $59,500 on Bitstamp, nearly 8% below Monday's high of $64,500, per Cointelegraph.
The Wall Street Journal reported the US could raise tariffs as soon as this week on China, Japan, South Korea and more than a dozen other countries, per CoinDesk.
US spot bitcoin funds lost $569.7 million on Monday 23 Nov, their fifth straight day of outflows; November's outflows reached a record $4.71 billion, per ChainCatcher.
Glassnode said a close below the June low of $58,500 could open a move toward bitcoin's "realized price" of $53,200, per CoinDesk.

stories.title: US consumer confidence jumps ahead of Wednesday's inflation report and the Fed's December decision
stories.summary: US consumer confidence rose sharply in November. Oxford Economics expects the Federal Reserve to raise rates by a quarter point at its 9 December decision, and higher rates tend to weigh on risky assets like crypto. October's PCE inflation report comes out Wednesday at 8:30am ET (20:30 Bangkok).
points: The Conference Board's consumer confidence index rose 11.4 points to 103.3 in November, its highest since January 2025, per the Conference Board.
October PCE prices are expected to rise 0.3% on the month and 3.8% on the year, after 0.5% and 3.6% in September, per Continuum Economics and the BEA.
Core PCE is expected at 3.2% on the year, up from 3.1% in September, per Continuum Economics and the BEA.
The Fed's next rate decision is Wed 9 Dec at 2:00pm ET, per the Federal Reserve.

sources.label: Conference Board via PR Newswire: consumer confidence surged in November

stories.title: Utah moves to drop criminal charges against Kalshi after the prediction market leaves the state
stories.summary: Utah's attorney general moved to drop criminal complaints against prediction-market company Kalshi and its executives after Kalshi stopped serving the state. Where Americans can legally use prediction markets is being fought out state by state and may end up at the Supreme Court.
points: Utah's attorney general moved to drop 14 criminal complaints, including a felony count, against Kalshi and its executives, per CoinDesk.
Utah AG Derek Brown: "Kalshi has pulled out of Utah, and if it returns, so will the charges," per CoinDesk.
Six other prediction-market firms also agreed to stay out of Utah, per CoinDesk.
Three of four federal appeals rulings have sided with the states, so the Supreme Court may have to decide, per CoinDesk.

sources.label: CoinDesk: Utah moves to drop criminal pursuit of Kalshi

briefs.summary: The draft bill would allow domestic token sales (ICOs) with a white paper filed with regulators and now goes to the National Assembly, per The Block.
